mentions.name: Sheets to PDF
mentions.description: This tool generates a personalized PDF for each row of a Google Sheet. After signing up and connecting a sheet, it uses AI to generate a template based on the data, which can be edited in a Notion-like editor, then produces PDFs for the whole sheet or a selected range of rows. Use cases include student certificates, client invoices, personalized reports, event tickets, conference badges, and contracts or offer letters.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a tool to generate a PDF for each row of a Google sheet. For example, you can generate 100 personalized PDFs (like certificates) for 100 students listed in a Google Sheet.

https://sheetstopdf.com/
